attributes.action: Do not introduce the crime and policing act law
attributes.additional_details:
We think that this law is overall just useless and just a waste of time and money. 

Sending police officers to peoples doors because of the type of porn they are interested or the type of “kinks” they have and then forcing them to delete a pornographic image of a consenting adult “face sitting” is a waste of time and money and overall and new low for the british government.
.
attributes.background: Do not introduce the new  2026 crime and policing act into UK law

rejection.details:
We believe we already have a petition open on the subject you are raising in your petition. You may wish to sign this petition instead:

Repeal and replace the 2026 ban on depictions of suffocation in pornography
